body:
Instagram Reels has emerged as one of the strongest tools that creators and brands can use to engage with new audiences.

Music and audio are important factors in ensuring your Reels are interesting. The question raised by many users is, 'How to Change the Audio on Instagram Reels After Posting?'

[Smmgen.com](http://smmgen.com) is here to answer that! Let's start!

## Insight into Instagram Reel Audio Rules

Currently, Instagram does not provide an option to edit the audio of a Reel directly once it has been published. It happens because the video that is uploaded to Instagram is associated with audio. To alter it would influence engagement numbers and licensing privileges of music songs.

Why so?

- Instagram monitors the use of audio, rights, and royalties.
- **Impact on your Reel:** The original sound is forever imprinted, although it is possible to update the sound differently.

This information can assist you in planning how to edit your Reels in advance before posting.

## How to Change Audio of Instagram Reels after Posting

Although you can not directly replace audio on a posted Reel, it is possible to create the effect through several workarounds:

### Option 1: Reupload, Re-edit, and Save it again

- Go to your Reel. Tap the three dots → Save → Save Video.
- Go to Instagram and open the video saved, and make a new reel.
- Add new audio, either from Instagram's music library or your own.
- Insert the sound Reel with the re-takes.

### Option 2: External Video Editors

You can add or replace audio using such apps as CapCut, InShot, or VN Video Editor. Export the edited video and put it up as a new Reel.

### Option 3: Remix Feature

You can remix your own Reel in case your Reel is public. The remix can involve incorporating another audio track, practically making a new version.

## Original Sounds to Retain Branding

Original sounds are one of the most effective means of making sure that your Reels are congruent with your brand. Original audio will make your content unique and avoid copyright problems. Even other users can use it when you create your own sound, and hence, your reach will increase organically.

You can do this by recording or adding your own audio when you are editing the Reel before posting. The Instagram Reels could be made more business-like with the help of such apps as InShot, CapCut, or VN Video Editor that enable you to combine several tracks or voiceovers.

Although you may wish to edit audio in the future, you will be guaranteed of the original sound, thus your content will remain original.

Also, original audio will allow you to develop your signature style. As an example, you could always open your videos with the same jingle or sound effect. In such a manner, in case a person learns about your content through a remix or a collaboration, they will immediately notice your brand, which increases both interest and loyalty.

## Reel Remixing is a Smart Strategy to Add Audio

The Remix option of Instagram is a smart way of updating your Reel and not necessarily reposting it. You can overlay new audio, add effects or edit clips to be more engaging by remixing your own Reel. This will also keep your original content likes and comments, and social proof will be preserved.

To remix, open your posted Reel, tap the three-dot menu, and choose Remix This Reel. Then you can select an audible track that is trending, an audio of another user, or your own. Modify timing, volume, and effects to match your video.

Remixing can be especially effective when the creators are inclined to take advantage of the trending sounds and retain the same content that is still needed.

It is also an excellent means of testing what audio can raise the reach and level of engagement. With remixing, your Reels are fresh, discoverable, and fit into the current trends without the loss of the momentum of the initial post.

## Pre-Posting Tips for Instagram Reels

- Test your Reel a few times so that the audio matches the video.
- Select trending or relevant songs that are in line with your brand voice or content style.
- Use the audio library or original sounds of Instagram.
- Remember length and transitions; longer Reels may cut off certain tracks.

Audio planning is a technique that can maximize its involvement and avoid additional efforts in the future.

## Use the Best sound with Proper Audio

Audio is not only an aesthetic matter, but it also affects the reach. The algorithm of Instagram supports the Reels that include trending or relevant sounds.

- Trending audio can make your Reel appear on the Explore page.
- Memorable, catchy songs are more likely to post more shares and views.
- Reels can be more shareable by syncing up your visual edits to the audio beat.

With a proper audio selection at the very beginning, you have even greater odds of viral growth.

## Avoiding Mistakes with Reposted Reels

In case you want to re-upload a Reel with new audio, do the following:

- You can delete the old Reel in case you do not wish to have the duplicate content.
- Mention in the caption to your audience that this is the revised version.
- Retain the description, hashtags, and tags so that the page can be searchable.
- Keep track of analytics to determine whether the new audio will enhance reach and engagement.

This approach keeps your profile clean and avoids confusing followers—especially important for creators using growth tools or an [SMM panel](/).

## Conclusion

It is not possible to change the audio of a Reel once it is posted directly, but it can be assisted with the help of workarounds such as Save, re-edit, or remix. Planning your audio before posting is the best solution to using your time wisely and ensuring that you engage people.

Trending or relevant sounds can be used to increase reach. Edits and transitions are made to the test to ensure maximum viewing. Blend Instagram tools and third-party editors. The appropriate strategy will ensure your Reels remain engaging, shareable, and optimized to grow, even when you have to make some optimizations after posting them.
